description: a25-native BASE decode template — the decode-fit pipeline's emit base (replaces the retired a24rc1q oracle). Names the a25 decode/guard modules and carries ONLY live a25 param keys with neutral placeholder values: look.* (aim gain/alpha/ffwd, turn dampener, hazard-discounted lead caps look.lead_hold_cap_frames/radial=4/5 @20Hz — the a24 deployed operating point, carried so every a25 decode-fit emits them, hold pass-through, tremor demoter), the move.commitment family, the attack_with operating point (attack.bias_vec / attack.stick_bias), weapon_ban (always [] on a25 — no ban gate in the attack_with decode), and the guard.* Gate B selection. Per-model values are filled by the decode-fit pipeline.
